caption: The drawing features four distinct horizontal bands, each filled with decorative geometric or abstract designs and a variety of colors. The top band consists of alternating red rectangles and yellow diamonds with blue dots, outlined in black. The second band has a swirling design predominantly in yellow, with touches of red, green, and blue, including symmetrical spiral shapes and pointed accents. The third band contains a central fan-like pattern with blue, black, light teal, and red areas, also with black outlines and a dot pattern in the middle. The bottom band displays a sequence of different geometric sections, including yellow, red, pink, and green sections, separated by black lines and filled with various patterns such as triangles, squares, and lattice motifs. The overall composition is centered on a beige background, and the band designs vary in geometric complexity and color placement.
title: Plate 49: Miscellaneous Design: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
